description: Elasticsearch searches documents and summarises their fields. It uses indexes, mappings and JSON requests. Learn a tiny book index, the difference between search and exact filters, and clear result summaries. Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
versionNote: Uses Elasticsearch 8+ REST request syntax and core search/aggregation features.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to explain why kind is a keyword while title is text
Learn to search for trip and compare the result
Learn to change the sort to descending pages
